svg.title: Pirate Cove layout
svg.text: PIRATE COVE · Pirate Cove · 92x62 tiles · road 5 tiles wide
Lap 313 tiles = 40,012 px · about 47 s per lap · closest the road comes to itself: 9.7 tiles
Dark channel = deep water (full speed). Pale water = shallows (slower). Patches = banks (slowest; hovercraft skim them).
Buoys mark the tight bends. White chevrons = current. Brown wedge = jump ramp. Orange = fizz/boost. Shore = wall.
Gold dashes = Shipwreck Passage: 46 tiles, 3.5 wide, instead of 37 tiles of main channel
Gold dashes = Smuggler's Gap: 14 tiles, 2.8 wide, instead of 38 tiles of main channel
